summary: Add Node bin entry (bin/flume.js) so npm's Windows shims resolve without sh.exe; package.json bin/scripts point at it.

new.description: #!/usr/bin/env node entry exec'ing dist/cli.js per §2 — mirror bin/flume's argv/stdio/exit propagation, no option parsing, no symlink-walk (Node resolves its own module path).

acceptance: npm pack --dry-run includes bin/flume.js; pnpm tsc --noEmit and pnpm test stay green; bin/flume (POSIX) unchanged and still present for direct callers.
notes: bin/flume stays in the package, just no longer what bin.flume points at. Win32 .cmd-shim verification is INSTALL-SMOKE-TEST's acceptance, not this entry's — this machine is win32 so that gate is real, not aspirational.

summary: Add scripts/smoke-install.mjs: pack -> install -> generated shim -> chain-load smoke test; wire into CI windows lane.

per.section: 3. Install smoke test — pack → install → shim → chain load

new.description: Plain-Node script per §3: npm pack repo, install tarball into fs.mkdtemp scratch dir, run generated shim (flume.cmd on win32, flume elsewhere) --version expect 0, scaffold minimal chain fixture, run shim's render <phase> expect 0. Print each step; abort non-zero on first failing step, naming it.

edit.description: wire smoke:install into the existing windows-latest lane per §3 (no new lane needed — one already exists).

acceptance: pnpm run smoke:install exits 0 on this win32 machine, log shows both --version and render passing through the .cmd shim; CI windows lane runs it green.
notes: Depends on NODE-BIN-ENTRY shipping first — otherwise the --version step fails against the known-bad sh.exe shim, which is the exact defect this test exists to catch.

summary: Add 0.6.1 CHANGELOG section: Fixed (Windows bin) and Added (smoke:install).

edit.description: New [0.6.1] section per §4: Fixed line (Windows bin was #!/bin/sh, shims needed sh.exe) and Added line (smoke:install pack-and-install test).

acceptance: CHANGELOG.md has an [0.6.1] section with the Fixed + Added lines; no version bump (human-performed at cut, per §4).
notes: Blocked on INSTALL-SMOKE-TEST rather than NODE-BIN-ENTRY directly — transitively covers both since that entry cannot ship before this one.
